name: Continental Manufacturing Chemist
old_description: Our R&D team specializes in crafting custom formulations, refining products, and performing in-house testing to deliver fast, reliable, and high-quality results. We focus on precision and innovation to bring your product vision to life.
about:
Continental Manufacturing Chemist (CMC) was founded in 1959 in Madrid, Iowa. The company expanded to a new facility in Huxley, Iowa, in 2018, growing its team to over 150 employees from across Central Iowa.

CMC operates as a contract manufacturer specializing in liquid and paste formulations for personal care and animal care markets. Its capabilities span custom formulation development, reverse engineering, and in-house testing through an R&D team, along with blending and batching in nine tanks ranging from 120 to 3,000 gallons. The facility handles filling from 0.25 ounce to one gallon, including tub, jar, and squeeze-tube lines, plus labeling, cartoning, and manual kitting. Production runs scale from low minimum orders of 10,000 units up to large-volume orders.

The company serves brands in personal care, animal care, baby care, body care, hair care, oral care, and cleaning categories. Customers range from start-ups seeking affordable small-batch production to established OEM and OTC brands. Specific products manufactured include kennel cleaners, wound sprays, flea and tick liquids, shampoos, conditioners, toothpastes, lotions, creams, ointments, body washes, mouthwashes, whitening gels, disinfectants, and hand sanitizers.

CMC differentiates itself with over 60 years of industry experience, turnkey project management from concept to packaging, and a quality system that is FDA registered, MoCRA compliant, and GMP certified. Its location along the Interstate 35 corridor near Iowa State University supports collaboration and rapid response to market demands.
